dialogue: The Grove stirs. The trees lean inward.
An elder figure emerges from the mist.
"You have cared well. Your companion has answered."
"The bond between you has deepened you both."
A warm light settles around your shoulders.
"You carry more now — in heart, and in stride."
The meadow hums with something low and ancient.
You find a hollow in the bank, shimmering faintly.
"This place remembers," the elder says from a distance.
